title: Velvety Bitter Malaysian Monterey Jack Cheese Quesadilla
description: A rich and savory quesadilla filled with velvety Malaysian-inspired bitter flavors and melted Monterey Jack cheese. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or meal prep snack.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the sliced bitter melon and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the gochujang sauce, cumin, and smoked paprika, stirring to combine.
Add the shredded Monterey Jack cheese and stir until melted and gooey.
Add the chopped cilantro and kaffir lime leaves, stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir until heated through.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with the bitter melon mixture.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook until crispy and golden, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve hot.
Serve the quesadillas with a side of Malaysian bitter melon salsa or raita for dipping.
